statewide.reason: The capstone merged dataset contains only 17 health districts, with incomplete weekly coverage. It is not a complete statewide district roster.

audit.grain: One Emergency Department combined-respiratory count per week-ending date and health district.
transformations: Trim district/date/count whitespace; no district aliases or boundary changes inferred.
Validate ISO dates and weekly cadence.
Reject duplicate week/district keys; no aggregation or deduplication.
Retain suppressed/missing counts as null with status; absent district-weeks remain absent.
Export only date, district, count, and missing-status fields. No percentage variables exported or summed.
